description: Every symbol's bhavcopy line for one trading date on one exchange, about 3,000 rows in full. Required: exchange, date. Returns 50 rows by default, up to 200, sorted by turnover, largest first. Filter with symbols or series and change the order with sort_by. meta.total counts rows after filters. Weekends and holidays have no rows; use status for the latest date. End of day data only, no intraday or live prices. Coverage: NSE from 2010-01-04, BSE from 2024-07-08. No API key needed.

exchange.description: Exchange: nse or bse, lower case.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from a truncated result.

series.description: Only this series, for example EQ on NSE. Case does not matter.

sort_by.description: Sort key. Numeric keys sort largest first; symbol sorts A to Z. change_pct is close against prev_close. Default turnover.

name: snapshot
title: One day, whole exchange
